title: Orell's & Kasama Labels
summary: Wrap-around labels for Premium Banana Thins and Sweet & Spicy Chili Jam.
description: Wrap-around labels for two products distributed by RGH Corporation: Orell's Premium Banana Thins, built around a friendly banana mascot, and KASAMA Cooperatives' Sweet & Spicy Chili Jam.
Both labels carry full nutrition panels, barcodes and regulatory text laid out to print-ready specifications.

images.caption: Label
images.alt: Wrap-around label for Orell's Premium Banana Thins in yellow, with a cartoon banana mascot, a nutrition facts panel and a barcode.

images.caption: Chili Jam Label
images.alt: Wrap-around label for Premium Sweet & Spicy Chili Jam in black and dark red, with garlic and chillies, nutrition facts and a barcode.
